nfc.reason: policy rate is constant at 7.00% throughout calibration; intercept and policy pass-through cannot be separately identified

households.reason: policy rate is constant at 7.00% throughout calibration; intercept and policy pass-through cannot be separately identified

structural_selection.rule: Expanding one-step origins; July 2024 cannot be predicted by the three-parameter candidate because all prior policy-rate observations are identical. Common model/baseline comparison therefore uses August-October 2024 and records the July identifiability failure separately.

nfc.interpretation: candidate is numerically slightly better on RMSE than the two baselines for these three observations, but the holdout is too small and was reached only after the candidate already failed the structural-selection gate

households.interpretation: candidate is only marginally better than persistence on n=3; this cannot rescue weak identification or the structural-selection failure

uncertainty_characterization: The calibration-only design is rank deficient; the central pass-through coefficient is not estimable under the pre-registered calibration slice.
After the first policy-rate changes enter the expanding sample, design conditioning remains extremely poor and parameter estimates vary materially by origin.
The household long-run pass-through estimate has an implausible negative sign throughout structural-selection origins; the NFC estimate falls sharply and turns negative in the pre-holdout fit.
Only three final holdout observations exist, so holdout error differences have low precision and are not used to reverse structural selection.
One-at-a-time sensitivity shows material parameter fragility, especially around the transformed intercept and household pass-through coefficient.

final_disposition.reason: Fails practical-identifiability and structural-selection/baseline gates. Published Romanian evidence still supports the existence of monetary transmission, but this particular three-parameter form is not validated by the frozen sample.
final_disposition.future_retest_requirement: Use a longer monthly sample with multiple policy cycles and a new untouched temporal evaluation window; consider parsimonious alternative parameterisations before adding controls.
